39529939.verification: per-arm counts 26/282 and 69/273 present in the committed source span

15740542.source: Can 2006 (PMID 15740542) abstract: 'S. boulardii also reduced the risk of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea ... [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]'. ENDPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor took the trial's ANY-diarrhoea figure (9/119 vs 29/127, RR 0.3) but our outcome is ANTIBIOTIC-ASSOCIATED diarrhoea, which the same abstract reports separately as 4/119 vs 22/127 (RR 0.2).
15740542.verification: AAD-specific arm counts 4/119 (3.4%) and 22/127 (17.3%) verbatim in the abstract; RR = (4/119)/(22/127) = 0.194, matching the stated RR 0.2 (0.07-0.5). Corrects an any-diarrhoea-vs-AAD wrong-endpoint (cycle 75 audit).

18026577.source: Beausoleil 2007 (PMID 18026577) abstract: 'antibiotic-associated diarrhea occurred in seven of 44 patients (15.9%) in the lactobacilli group and in 16 of 45 patients (35.6%) in the placebo group (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.125 to 0.944)'. SCALE CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor pooled the source ODDS RATIO 0.34 into this RR-family pool; the per-arm counts give the count-based RR directly, consistent with the other count-based trials.
18026577.verification: Arm counts 7/44 (15.9%) and 16/45 (35.6%) verbatim in the abstract; count RR = (7/44)/(16/45) = 0.447. Replaces the OR 0.34 the extractor took, removing an OR-in-RR-pool scale mix (cycle 75 audit).

24456384.source: Wright 2015 (PMID 24456384) abstract: '41 received the active Yakult (12.2% diarrhoea) and 46 received placebo (8.7% diarrhoea).' Per-arm AAD counts derived by percentage-corroboration from the stated percentages and arm denominators (each is the UNIQUE integer consistent with the printed percent): 5 of 41 = 12.195% (rounds to 12.2%; 4/41=9.8%, 6/41=14.6% do not) probiotic, 4 of 46 = 8.696% (rounds to 8.7%; 3/46=6.5%, 5/46=10.9% do not) placebo. Double-blind RCT (ACTRN12609000429257), L. casei Shirota vs placebo, geriatric inpatients; standard AAD outcome. Abstract path had declared it absent because the counts are given only as percentages, not as 'X of Y'.
24456384.verification: Percentage-derived arm counts 5/41 (12.2%) and 4/46 (8.7%) uniquely determined by the abstract percentages + denominators; count RR = (5/41)/(4/46) = 1.402 (probiotic slightly WORSE), so this addition moves the pool TOWARD the null, not toward benefit. Recovers a genuinely eligible declared-absent trial (extractor could not parse the 'N received X (P% diarrhoea)' format).
